title: Grade 4 French — Wed, Jun 03
description: Verbes en -IR (2e groupe) — Day 3 of 5: More -IR verbs and full conjugation practice
subject: french

questions.question: What does 'rougir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Rougir' = to blush / to turn red. It comes from 'rouge' (red). 'Elle rougit.' = She blushes.

questions.question: What does 'guérir' mean?
options: To heal / to cure / to get well
questions.explanation: 'Guérir' = to heal / to get well. 'Le malade guérit.' = The patient gets well.

questions.question: What does 'nourrir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Nourrir' = to feed / to nourish. 'Je nourris le chat.' = I feed the cat.

questions.question: Complete: 'Je ___ les oiseaux.' (nourrir — I feed the birds)
Complete: 'Tu ___ devant tes amis.' (rougir — you blush in front of your friends)
Complete: 'Le malade ___ lentement.' (guérir — the patient heals slowly)
What does 'ralentir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Ralentir' = to slow down. 'La voiture ralentit.' = The car slows down.

questions.question: Complete: 'Nous ___ avant le virage.' (ralentir — we slow down before the bend)
What does 'punir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Punir' = to punish. 'Le professeur punit l'élève.' = The teacher punishes the pupil.

questions.question: Complete: 'Vous ___ toujours la bonne réponse.' (choisir)
questions.explanation: 'Vous choisissez toujours la bonne réponse.' = You always choose the right answer. Vous → -issez.

questions.question: Which is the full singular set of 'finir'?
options: je finis, tu finis, il finit
je finit, tu finis, il finis
je finis, tu finit, il finit
je finie, tu finis, il finit
questions.explanation: Singular: je finis, tu finis, il/elle finit. (je and tu both -is, il -it.)

questions.question: Complete: 'Les fleurs ___ au printemps.' (grandir — flowers grow in spring)
Complete: 'Tu ___ le formulaire.' (remplir — you fill the form)
What does 'choisir' become for 'nous'?
questions.explanation: 'Nous choisissons' = we choose. Don't forget the -iss-.

questions.question: Complete: 'Je ___ de lire ce livre.' (finir — I finish reading this book)
questions.explanation: 'Je finis de lire ce livre.' Je → -is.
